description: This file defines middleware functions for security-related HTTP handling in a Node.js/Express application. It includes functions for CORS configuration, Helmet security headers, and rate limiting, with dynamic configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a CORS middleware with a whitelist derived from environment variables, handling origin validation and preflight requests.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a Helmet middleware with relaxed Content Security Policy and cross-origin resource policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Builds and returns a rate limiting middleware with configurable window, max requests, and skipping GET requests based on environment variables.
